signature.name: West Lake
signature.detail: Hangzhou's iconic lake, a UNESCO site with causeways, pagodas and gardens. Best visited early morning to avoid crowds; free to walk, boat rides cost extra.

signature.name: Lingyin Temple
signature.detail: One of China's most important Buddhist temples, set in a forested valley with ancient grottoes. Go early to avoid crowds; modest dress recommended; entry ticket required.

signature.name: Leifeng Pagoda
signature.detail: Historic pagoda with panoramic views over West Lake. Visit near sunset for the best light; ticket required; elevators available.
